Updated September 26, 2026: we re-checked every agency against its own website and n8n's expert partner directory. One agency was removed because its site no longer describes n8n work, one partner from n8n's directory was added, and the list has 12 entries, seven of them listed by n8n. Previous roster review: July 2026.

The best n8n agency for most teams is ManasFlow, followed by Goodspeed for automation-first product builds. If you want a partner that n8n itself lists, seven agencies here appear in n8n's expert partner directory: Goodspeed, Makeitfuture, ennoia, PulpSense, Hyperstack Studio, TrueHorizon AI and Avanai. n8n went from niche fair-code workflow tool to the default automation layer for AI-native teams in under three years. Self-hosted, code-friendly, AI-aware, with a community that ships new nodes every week. It solves the problems most no-code automation tools cannot: data sovereignty, custom logic, deep integrations, and the kind of pricing that does not collapse the moment you add a fourth automation.

The trade-off is that n8n is not Zapier. Wiring up a serious automation system means thinking about webhooks, error handling, queue mode, RBAC, secrets management, observability, and how to ship updates without breaking yesterday's flows. That is why most teams beyond the prototype stage hire an n8n agency, and our guide to n8n development services walks through what that engagement typically includes.
This guide compares the 12 best n8n agencies in 2026, with honest pros, cons, pricing, and a framework to pick the right partner for your automation stack.
How we picked these 12 n8n agencies

We scored each agency on four things, in this order: (1) n8n work confirmed on the agency's own website, (2) depth on the AI layer (agents, RAG, LLM steps inside workflows), (3) how much it publishes about pricing and engagement shape, and (4) delivery fit, meaning languages and hosting options. Seven entries (Goodspeed, Makeitfuture, ennoia, PulpSense, Hyperstack Studio, TrueHorizon AI and Avanai) appear in n8n's expert partner directory (checked 2026-09-26), and we then confirmed each one's services on its own site. N8N Lab, Bacancy, Your Product Partners and Flowlyn did not appear in that directory when we checked, so for them we relied on their own websites only. Every figure attributed to an agency is the agency's own published claim. We did not pull review profiles and we do not claim hands-on testing of any agency.
Disclosure: ManasFlow publishes this list and ranks itself first. Judge our entry by the same evidence bar: it links to our published case studies, and it lists who should skip us.
Best n8n agencies: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall for AI-native automation: full strategy + n8n build + AI agents + RAG + post-launch maintenance under one roof, with multilingual delivery (EN/FR/AR).
Goodspeed: Best for automation-first digital products: says it has priced 200+ n8n automation projects and is listed in n8n's partner directory.
N8N Lab: Best for compliance-heavy n8n workflows: describes itself as an n8n certified agency and reports 500+ automations deployed (its own figures).
Bacancy Technology: Best for dedicated n8n developer hiring: says it onboards developers in 48 hours from a bench of 1,050+ vetted engineers.
Makeitfuture: Best for multi-platform teams: n8n, Make, Zapier and Airtable builds from offices in London, Paris and Cluj-Napoca.
ennoia: Best for German and GDPR-bound teams: n8n hosting in German data centers, consulting and team training.
PulpSense: Best for B2B growth teams: AI agents and n8n workflows across lead gen, sales ops, onboarding and reporting.
Hyperstack Studio: Best for French-speaking scale-ups: n8n alongside Airtable, Glide, Xano and data tooling from Paris.
TrueHorizon AI: Best for enterprise AI programs on n8n: Boston-based, with a four-step discovery to scale process.
Avanai: Best for enterprises connecting SAP to n8n: publishes its own SAP OData community node for n8n.
Your Product Partners (YPP): Best for product-level automation systems: builds websites, apps and automations with Zapier, n8n, Bubble and Framer.
Flowlyn: Best for AI voice agents next to workflow automation: lists n8n, Make and Zapier as the platforms it uses.

1. ManasFlow, best overall n8n agency for AI-native automation

Start with the shipped work. ManasFlow has five published case studies, including a compliance automation build that replaced manual passport checks with AI document verification, a marketing system that automates 95% of campaign distribution, and a support chatbot that resolves Tier-1 tickets around the clock. Simple n8n integrations typically go live 1 to 2 weeks after the audit, and production systems with AI steps take 4 to 8 weeks.

ManasFlow treats n8n as the connective tissue of a broader AI delivery stack: discovery and scoping, n8n workflow build (cloud or self-hosted), AI agent and RAG integration where the use case calls for it, observability, secrets management, and post-launch maintenance. The advantage for founders and ops leads is that you do not need three vendors; strategy, automation engineering, and the AI layer live under one roof.

We work mostly with SaaS teams, ops leads at scaling startups, and AI-first product teams that need more than a simple Zapier replacement. Typical engagements: lead routing across HubSpot/Salesforce/Slack, RAG-powered support deflection, multi-step LLM pipelines orchestrated through n8n, billing event handling across Stripe/Quickbooks, and internal AI tools for sales and CX teams. Multilingual delivery (English, French, Arabic) makes us a natural pick for EU, MENA, and bilingual North American teams. n8n is one piece of the stack: if you want to work with an AI automation agency that scopes the audit, builds the workflow, and stays on for maintenance, that page covers pricing and process end to end.

2. Goodspeed, best for automation-first digital products

Goodspeed says it has priced 200+ n8n automation projects and lists itself as an official n8n partner. It treats automation as a product design discipline, not a back-office chore, and fits startups building products where the automation IS the product: lead capture funnels, content engines, internal AI tools that ship to customers as features.

3. N8N Lab, best for compliance-heavy n8n workflows

N8N Lab describes itself as an 'n8n certified agency' and reports 500+ automations deployed (its own figures). It did not appear in n8n's expert partner directory when we checked on 2026-09-26. They build autonomous agents for lead qualification, compliance workflows, and operational pipelines: the cases where the workflow has to be auditable and reliable, not clever alone.
If your project lives under GDPR scrutiny, financial services regulation, or healthcare data rules, ask N8N Lab for a shipped example from your sector before you sign.

5. Makeitfuture, best for teams that run n8n next to Make and Zapier

Makeitfuture is an automation agency that builds on n8n, Make, Zapier, Airtable, HubSpot and boost.space, and its site lists n8n automation services and n8n app development by name. Its services also cover AI agents, CRM and ERP integration, platform migration and ongoing support. The site gives office addresses in London, Paris and Cluj-Napoca.

It fits a team that already runs automations on more than one platform and wants one partner for all of them. Its homepage claims 15,000+ AI automations, 500+ clients and 7+ years of experience. Those are the agency's own figures.

6. ennoia, best for German teams that need n8n hosted in Germany

ennoia is a Berlin-based n8n partner for mid-sized German companies. Its site offers n8n hosting in certified German data centers with GDPR compliance, n8n consulting and development, and onboarding and training for your team on n8n best practices. It also hosts Open WebUI and managed Ollama GPU servers, which matters if you want local models running next to your workflows.
The site is in German and describes ennoia as a certified n8n partner. The founders claim over 20 years of experience in technology and entrepreneurship.
